behavior: The Go command preserves every existing accepted and rejected doc-path behavior, including discovery, globs, escapes, vault paths, Windows worktrees and zsh source invariants.
The full repository scan completes in at most two seconds on Windows and is deterministically ordered.
PR 1 exposes `dotf lint doc-paths` and CI coverage while leaving the shell hook operational.
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd -run TestLintDocPaths && test -z "$(git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- .pre-commit-config.yaml scripts/check-doc-paths.sh tests/check-doc-paths.bats tests/check-doc-paths-real.bats)"

behavior: After release, pre-commit uses the CLI and the shell guard plus both BATS files are absent with no dangling references.
verification: test ! -e scripts/check-doc-paths.sh && test ! -e tests/check-doc-paths.bats && test ! -e tests/check-doc-paths-real.bats && ! git grep -n 'check-doc-paths.sh'

behavior: Governed instruction or policy changes trigger the Go guard before merge.
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/docpaths -run TestCurrentRepository && git grep -n 'harness/doc-paths.json' -- .github/workflows/cli.yml

behavior: Invalid policy, Git failures, missing paths, empty globs and repo escapes fail non-zero; inability to run never becomes success.
The checkout-owned policy is versioned and rejects unknown fields or unsupported versions before scanning.
Behavior tests are synthetic and the real-repository performance check is read-only.
